data.title: Rocket Launch Multiplication by 10s!
data.description: Connect skip counting by tens to multiplication facts as our rocket blasts off to the stars.

character.imagePrompt: A shiny red rocket ship blasting off into space leaving a fiery trail

challenges.instruction: The rocket jumped from 0 to 10. How many jumps of 10 did it make? Finish the multiplication fact.
challenges.hint: Count the jumps, one arc at a time.
